result.title: Latent-Lens: Visual Perception in Small Language Models Through Latent Communication
result.summary: Bridging independent vision-language models (VLMs) and small language models (SLMs) in a modular multi-agent system typically forces them to exchange information as discrete text, which creates a lossy bottleneck for spatial and fine-grained details. This constraint is especially acute for SLMs, whose limited capacity makes them more reliant on the quality of the input signal. Recent latent-communication methods exchange states between language models. How a VLM can pass visual information to a separately pretrained text-only SLM though remains unexplored. We propose \textbf{Latent-Lens}, a lightweight codec that bridges the representation gap between a frozen VLM and a frozen SLM directly in latent space, enabling them to communicate purely through hidden states. The codec consists of a domain encoder that projects hidden states from the VLM into the SLM's embedding space, and an attention decoder formalised as a LoRA that teaches the SLM to attend to these visual prefixes, while training only ${\sim}1.6$M parameters (0.2\% of the combined model size). On visual question answering (CLEVR, GQA), Latent-Lens achieves $81.0\pm7.9$\% and $65.4\pm5.4$\%, compared with $58.3\pm5.7$\% and $61.8\pm1.0$\% for text communication with the same LoRA budget (+30.2--69.8pp relative to frozen text communication), while on image captioning (Flickr8k) it improves over the same baseline by +16.5 (+18.8 frozen). We also evaluate Latent-Lens with TinyLlama-1.1B and InternVL2-1B, which use different architectures, vocabularies, and hidden dimensions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Latent-Lens：用约 1.6M 参数（域编码器 + 形式化为 LoRA 的注意力解码器）把冻结 VLM 的隐状态投影进冻结 SLM 的嵌入空间，使视觉信息以 latent 前缀而非离散文本传给小型语言模型，并在 CLEVR、GQA、Flickr8k 上与同等 LoRA 预算的文本通信对比报告提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及「视觉细节是否保留在内部状态中」与视觉旁路问题，提供 latent 前缀与文本瓶颈的对照；其视觉—语言表示对齐方式、latent 前缀的可解释性及对 SLM 容量和前缀长度的依赖可供核查。
